name: metal
description: Small files, low-level languages, a compiler that refuses. Three rules, two enforced by hook.

plugins.name: metal
plugins.description: Small files, low-level languages, a compiler that refuses. Denies any source file over 300 lines at write time, warns at 220 while there is still room to split well, defaults every new project to C++, and checks that C++ projects actually build with -Wall -Wextra -Werror.
